arabic1: ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب فاختلف فيه ۚ ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لقضي بينهم ۚ وإنهم لفي شك منه مريب
arabic2: ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب فاختلف فيه ۗ ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لقضي بينهم ۚ وإنهم لفي شك منه مريب
english1: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt.
english2: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt.

arabic1: هو الذي أرسل رسوله بالهدى ودين الحق ليظهره على الدين كله ولو كره المشركون
arabic2: هو الذي أرسل رسوله بالهدى ودين الحق ليظهره على الدين كله ولو كره المشركون
english1: It is He who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although they who associate others with Allah dislike it.
english2: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allah dislike it.

arabic1: ولقد استهزئ برسل من قبلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
arabic2: ولقد استهزئ برسل من قبلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
english1: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule.
english2: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

arabic1: يا أيها النبي جاهد الكفار والمنافقين واغلظ عليهم ۚ ومأواهم جهنم ۖ وبئس المصير
arabic2: يا أيها النبي جاهد الكفار والمنافقين واغلظ عليهم ۚ ومأواهم جهنم ۖ وبئس المصير
english1: O Prophet, fight against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.
english2: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.

arabic1: فإذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له ساجدين
arabic2: فإذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له ساجدين
english1: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
english2: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

arabic1: سبح لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۖ وهو العزيز الحكيم
arabic2: سبح لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۖ وهو العزيز الحكيم
english1: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
english2: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic1: الذين يقيمون الصلاة ويؤتون الزكاة وهم بالآخرة هم يوقنون
arabic2: الذين يقيمون الصلاة ويؤتون الزكاة وهم بالآخرة هم يوقنون
english1: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
english2: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith].

arabic1: لقد وعدنا نحن وآباؤنا هذا من قبل إن هذا إلا أساطير الأولين
arabic2: لقد وعدنا هذا نحن وآباؤنا من قبل إن هذا إلا أساطير الأولين
english1: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
english2: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."

arabic1: انظر كيف ضربوا لك الأمثال فضلوا فلا يستطيعون سبيلا
arabic2: انظر كيف ضربوا لك الأمثال فضلوا فلا يستطيعون سبيلا
english1: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
english2: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.

arabic1: وما تأتيهم من آية من آيات ربهم إلا كانوا عنها معرضين
arabic2: وما تأتيهم من آية من آيات ربهم إلا كانوا عنها معرضين
english1: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away therefrom.
english2: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

arabic1: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتى يلاقوا يومهم الذي يوعدون
arabic2: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتى يلاقوا يومهم الذي يوعدون
english1: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
english2: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -

arabic1: ليكفروا بما آتيناهم ۚ فتمتعوا ۖ فسوف تعلمون
arabic2: ليكفروا بما آتيناهم ۚ فتمتعوا فسوف تعلمون
english1: So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
english2: So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.

arabic1: إلا الذين تابوا من بعد ذلك وأصلحوا فإن الله غفور رحيم
arabic2: إلا الذين تابوا من بعد ذلك وأصلحوا فإن الله غفور رحيم
english1: Except for those who repent after that and correct themselves. For indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
english2: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic1: ذلك بما قدمت أيديكم وأن الله ليس بظلام للعبيد
arabic2: ذلك بما قدمت أيديكم وأن الله ليس بظلام للعبيد
english1: That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allah is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
english2: That is for what your hands have put forth [of evil] and because Allah is not ever unjust to His servants."

arabic1: وما خلقنا السماء والأرض وما بينهما لاعبين
arabic2: وما خلقنا السماوات والأرض وما بينهما لاعبين
english1: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
english2: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

arabic1: خالدين فيها ۖ لا يخفف عنهم العذاب ولا هم ينظرون
arabic2: خالدين فيها لا يخفف عنهم العذاب ولا هم ينظرون
english1: Abiding eternally therein. The punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.
english2: Abiding eternally therein. The punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.

arabic1: إلا على أزواجهم أو ما ملكت أيمانهم فإنهم غير ملومين
arabic2: إلا على أزواجهم أو ما ملكت أيمانهم فإنهم غير ملومين
english1: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
english2: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -

arabic1: قل إني أخاف إن عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
arabic2: قل إني أخاف إن عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم
english1: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
english2: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."

arabic1: ولقد أرسلنا موسى بآياتنا وسلطان مبين
arabic2: ولقد أرسلنا موسى بآياتنا وسلطان مبين
english1: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
english2: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority

arabic2: كلوا واشربوا هنيئا بما كنتم تعملون
english1: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
english2: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

english2: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

arabic1: قال ربكم ورب آبائكم الأولين
arabic2: الله ربكم ورب آبائكم الأولين
english1: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
english2: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"

arabic1: تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز العليم
arabic2: تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز الحكيم
english1: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
english2: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic1: تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز العليم
arabic2: تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز الحكيم
english1: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
english2: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic2: تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز العليم
english1: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
english2: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

arabic1: فألقى عصاه فإذا هي ثعبان مبين
arabic2: فألقى عصاه فإذا هي ثعبان مبين
english1: So Moses threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent, manifest.
english2: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.

arabic1: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا تأثيما
arabic2: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا كذابا
english1: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
english2: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

arabic1: قالوا أإذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أإنا لمبعوثون
arabic2: أإذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أإنا لمبعوثون
english1: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
english2: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

arabic1: ولوطا إذ قال لقومه أتأتون الفاحشة ما سبقكم بها من أحد من العالمين
arabic2: ولوطا إذ قال لقومه إنكم لتأتون الفاحشة ما سبقكم بها من أحد من العالمين
english1: And [We had sent] Lot when he said to his people, "Do you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds?
english2: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.

arabic1: ليكفروا بما آتيناهم وليتمتعوا ۖ فسوف يعلمون
arabic2: ليكفروا بما آتيناهم ۚ فتمتعوا فسوف تعلمون
english1: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.
english2: So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.

arabic1: ليكفروا بما آتيناهم ۚ فتمتعوا ۖ فسوف تعلمون
arabic2: ليكفروا بما آتيناهم وليتمتعوا ۖ فسوف يعلمون
english1: So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
english2: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.

arabic1: الحمد لله رب العالمين
arabic2: والحمد لله رب العالمين
english1: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -
english2: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

arabic1: فأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون
arabic2: وأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون
english1: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
english2: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

arabic1: فأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون
arabic2: فأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتلاومون
english1: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
english2: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.

arabic1: فنجيناه وأهله أجمعين
arabic2: إذ نجيناه وأهله أجمعين
english1: So We saved him and his family, all,
english2: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

arabic1: الر ۚ تلك آيات الكتاب وقرآن مبين
arabic2: طس ۚ تلك آيات القرآن وكتاب مبين
english1: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.
english2: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book

arabic1: ذلك بأنهم شاقوا الله ورسوله ۚ ومن يشاقق الله ورسوله فإن الله شديد العقاب
arabic2: ذلك بأنهم شاقوا الله ورسوله ۖ ومن يشاق الله فإن الله شديد العقاب
english1: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger - indeed, Allah is severe in penalty.
english2: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah - then indeed, Allah is severe in penalty.

arabic1: وإذ قلنا ادخلوا هذه القرية فكلوا منها حيث شئتم رغدا وادخلوا الباب سجدا وقولوا حطة نغفر لكم خطاياكم ۚ وسنزيد المحسنين
arabic2: وإذ قيل لهم اسكنوا هذه القرية وكلوا منها حيث شئتم وقولوا حطة وادخلوا الباب سجدا نغفر لكم خطيئاتكم ۚ سنزيد المحسنين
english1: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens.' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."
english2: And [mention, O Muhammad], when it was said to them, "Dwell in this city and eat from it wherever you will and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens,' and enter the gate bowing humbly; We will [then] forgive you your sins. We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."

arabic1: سنة الله في الذين خلوا من قبل ۖ ولن تجد لسنة الله تبديلا
arabic2: سنة الله التي قد خلت من قبل ۖ ولن تجد لسنة الله تبديلا
english1: [This is] the established way of Allah with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allah any change.
english2: [This is] the established way of Allah which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allah any change.

arabic1: وقالوا إن هي إلا حياتنا الدنيا وما نحن بمبعوثين
arabic2: إن هي إلا حياتنا الدنيا نموت ونحيا وما نحن بمبعوثين
english1: And they say, "There is none but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected."
english2: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.

arabic1: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم أجر غير ممنون
arabic2: إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات فلهم أجر غير ممنون
english1: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.
english2: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

arabic1: إن هذه أمتكم أمة واحدة وأنا ربكم فاعبدون
arabic2: وإن هذه أمتكم أمة واحدة وأنا ربكم فاتقون
english1: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
english2: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."

arabic1: فبدل الذين ظلموا قولا غير الذي قيل لهم فأنزلنا على الذين ظلموا رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يفسقون
arabic2: فبدل الذين ظلموا منهم قولا غير الذي قيل لهم فأرسلنا عليهم رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يظلمون
english1: But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying.
english2: But those who wronged among them changed [the words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them. So We sent upon them a punishment from the sky for the wrong that they were doing.

arabic1: وما جعله الله إلا بشرى لكم ولتطمئن قلوبكم به ۗ وما النصر إلا من عند الله العزيز الحكيم
arabic2: وما جعله الله إلا بشرى ولتطمئن به قلوبكم ۚ وما النصر إلا من عند الله ۚ إن الله عزيز حكيم
english1: And Allah made it not except as [a sign of] good tidings for you and to reassure your hearts thereby. And victory is not except from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise -
english2: And Allah made it not but good tidings and so that your hearts would be assured thereby. And victory is not but from Allah. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.

arabic1: وهو الذي أنشأ لكم السمع والأبصار والأفئدة ۚ قليلا ما تشكرون
arabic2: قل هو الذي أنشأكم وجعل لكم السمع والأبصار والأفئدة ۖ قليلا ما تشكرون
english1: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
english2: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

arabic1: قل سيروا في الأرض ثم انظروا كيف كان عاقبة المكذبين
arabic2: قل سيروا في الأرض فانظروا كيف كان عاقبة المجرمين
english1: Say, "Travel through the land; then observe how was the end of the deniers."
english2: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."

arabic1: فادخلوا أبواب جهنم خالدين فيها ۖ فلبئس مثوى المتكبرين
arabic2: ادخلوا أبواب جهنم خالدين فيها ۖ فبئس مثوى المتكبرين
english1: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
english2: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

arabic1: وإن ربك ليعلم ما تكن صدورهم وما يعلنون
arabic2: وربك يعلم ما تكن صدورهم وما يعلنون
english1: And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
english2: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.

arabic1: فادخلوا أبواب جهنم خالدين فيها ۖ فلبئس مثوى المتكبرين
arabic2: قيل ادخلوا أبواب جهنم خالدين فيها ۖ فبئس مثوى المتكبرين
english1: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
english2: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

arabic1: وما أدراك ما القارعة
arabic2: وما أدراك ما الحطمة
english1: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
english2: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?

arabic2: وما أدراك ما القارعة

english2: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

arabic2: تلك آيات الكتاب المبين

english2: These are the verses of the clear Book.

arabic2: ۞ وعندهم قاصرات الطرف أتراب
english1: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
english2: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.

arabic2: إن المتقين في جنات ونعيم

english2: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

arabic2: اذهب إلى فرعون إنه طغى

arabic2: يأتوك بكل سحار عليم

arabic2: إن المتقين في جنات ونهر

arabic1: وقلنا يا آدم اسكن أنت وزوجك الجنة وكلا منها رغدا حيث شئتما ولا تقربا هذه الشجرة فتكونا من الظالمين
arabic2: ويا آدم اسكن أنت وزوجك الجنة فكلا من حيث شئتما ولا تقربا هذه الشجرة فتكونا من الظالمين
english1: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."
english2: And "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat from wherever you will but do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."

arabic1: كدأب آل فرعون والذين من قبلهم ۚ كذبوا بآياتنا فأخذهم الله بذنوبهم ۗ والله شديد العقاب
arabic2: كدأب آل فرعون ۙ والذين من قبلهم ۚ كفروا بآيات الله فأخذهم الله بذنوبهم ۗ إن الله قوي شديد العقاب
english1: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and those before them. They denied Our signs, so Allah seized them for their sins. And Allah is severe in penalty.
english2: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They disbelieved in the signs of Allah, so Allah seized them for their sins. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and severe in penalty.

arabic1: ومن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا أو كذب بآياته ۗ إنه لا يفلح الظالمون
arabic2: فمن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا أو كذب بآياته ۚ إنه لا يفلح المجرمون
english1: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie or denies His verses? Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed.
english2: So who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah or denies His signs? Indeed, the criminals will not succeed

arabic1: فأصابهم سيئات ما عملوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
arabic2: وبدا لهم سيئات ما عملوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
english1: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
english2: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

arabic1: ولما بلغ أشده آتيناه حكما وعلما ۚ وكذلك نجزي المحسنين
arabic2: ولما بلغ أشده واستوى آتيناه حكما وعلما ۚ وكذلك نجزي المحسنين
english1: And when Joseph reached maturity, We gave him judgment and knowledge. And thus We reward the doers of good.
english2: And when he attained his full strength and was [mentally] mature, We bestowed upon him judgement and knowledge. And thus do We reward the doers of good.

arabic1: هو الذي أرسل رسوله بالهدى ودين الحق ليظهره على الدين كله ۚ وكفى بالله شهيدا
arabic2: هو الذي أرسل رسوله بالهدى ودين الحق ليظهره على الدين كله ولو كره المشركون
english1: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness.
english2: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allah dislike it.

arabic1: هو الذي أرسل رسوله بالهدى ودين الحق ليظهره على الدين كله ولو كره المشركون
arabic2: هو الذي أرسل رسوله بالهدى ودين الحق ليظهره على الدين كله ۚ وكفى بالله شهيدا
english1: It is He who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although they who associate others with Allah dislike it.
english2: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness.

arabic1: ألم تعلم أن الله له ملك السماوات والأرض ۗ وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
arabic2: إن الله له ملك السماوات والأرض ۖ يحيي ويميت ۚ وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
english1: Do you not know that to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and [that] you have not besides Allah any protector or any helper?
english2: Indeed, to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He gives life and causes death. And you have not besides Allah any protector or any helper.

arabic1: ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۚ يغفر لمن يشاء ويعذب من يشاء ۚ والله غفور رحيم
arabic2: ولله ملك السماوات والأرض ۚ يغفر لمن يشاء ويعذب من يشاء ۚ وكان الله غفورا رحيما
english1: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
english2: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.

arabic1: إنكم لتأتون الرجال شهوة من دون النساء ۚ بل أنتم قوم مسرفون
arabic2: أئنكم لتأتون الرجال شهوة من دون النساء ۚ بل أنتم قوم تجهلون
english1: Indeed, you approach men with desire, instead of women. Rather, you are a transgressing people."
english2: Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."

arabic1: وأرادوا به كيدا فجعلناهم الأخسرين
arabic2: فأرادوا به كيدا فجعلناهم الأسفلين
english1: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers.
english2: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.

arabic1: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
arabic2: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
english1: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
english2: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

arabic2: تلك آيات الكتاب الحكيم
english1: These are the verses of the clear Book.
english2: These are verses of the wise Book,

arabic1: مناع للخير معتد مريب
arabic2: مناع للخير معتد أثيم
english1: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
english2: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,

arabic1: تلك آيات الكتاب المبين
arabic2: تلك آيات الكتاب الحكيم
english1: These are the verses of the clear Book.
english2: These are verses of the wise Book,

arabic1: وهل أتاك حديث موسى
arabic2: هل أتاك حديث موسى
english1: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
english2: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

arabic1: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
arabic2: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
english1: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
english2: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic1: وما أدراك ما سجين
arabic2: وما أدراك ما هيه
english1: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
english2: And what can make you know what that is?

arabic1: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
arabic2: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
english1: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
english2: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic1: وما أدراك ما سقر
arabic2: وما أدراك ما سجين
english1: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
english2: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

arabic1: ألم نجعل الأرض كفاتا
arabic2: ألم نجعل الأرض مهادا
english1: Have We not made the earth a container
english2: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

arabic1: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
arabic2: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
english1: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
english2: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic1: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
arabic2: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
english1: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
english2: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic1: وما أدراك ما سقر
arabic2: وما أدراك ما هيه
english1: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
english2: And what can make you know what that is?

arabic1: وصاحبته وأخيه
arabic2: وصاحبته وبنيه
english1: And his wife and his brother
english2: And his wife and his children,

arabic1: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
arabic2: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
english1: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
english2: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic1: والسماء ذات الحبك
arabic2: والسماء ذات البروج
english1: By the heaven containing pathways,
english2: By the sky containing great stars

arabic1: وما أدراك ما سقر
arabic2: وما أدراك ما عليون
english1: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
english2: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?

arabic1: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
arabic2: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
english1: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
english2: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic1: هل أتاك حديث الجنود
arabic2: هل أتاك حديث الغاشية
english1: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
english2: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?

arabic1: إنما توعدون لصادق
arabic2: إنما توعدون لواقع
english1: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
english2: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

arabic1: وما أدراك ما عليون
arabic2: وما أدراك ما هيه
english1: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
english2: And what can make you know what that is?

arabic1: وأبصر فسوف يبصرون
arabic2: فستبصر ويبصرون
english1: And see, for they are going to see.
english2: So you will see and they will see

arabic1: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
arabic2: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
english1: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
english2: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic1: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
arabic2: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
english1: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
english2: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic1: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
arabic2: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
english1: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
english2: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic1: والليل إذا يغشاها
arabic2: والليل إذا يغشى
english1: And [by] the night when it covers it
english2: By the night when it covers

arabic1: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
arabic2: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
english1: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
english2: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

arabic1: وإذا أنعمنا على الإنسان أعرض ونأى بجانبه ۖ وإذا مسه الشر كان يئوسا
arabic2: وإذا أنعمنا على الإنسان أعرض ونأى بجانبه وإذا مسه الشر فذو دعاء عريض
english1: And when We bestow favor upon the disbeliever, he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
english2: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.

arabic1: ولن يتمنوه أبدا بما قدمت أيديهم ۗ والله عليم بالظالمين
arabic2: ولا يتمنونه أبدا بما قدمت أيديهم ۚ والله عليم بالظالمين
english1: But they will never wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
english2: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers.

arabic1: قالوا أإذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أإنا لمبعوثون
arabic2: أإذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أإنا لمدينون
english1: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
english2: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"

arabic1: فاختلف الأحزاب من بينهم ۖ فويل للذين كفروا من مشهد يوم عظيم
arabic2: فاختلف الأحزاب من بينهم ۖ فويل للذين ظلموا من عذاب يوم أليم
english1: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
english2: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.

arabic1: وقالوا أإذا كنا عظاما ورفاتا أإنا لمبعوثون خلقا جديدا
arabic2: قالوا أإذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أإنا لمبعوثون
english1: And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"
english2: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

arabic1: فالذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم مغفرة ورزق كريم
arabic2: ليجزي الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات ۚ أولئك لهم مغفرة ورزق كريم
english1: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
english2: That He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Those will have forgiveness and noble provision.

arabic1: إن الذين آمنوا والذين هادوا والنصارى والصابئين من آمن بالله واليوم الآخر وعمل صالحا فلهم أجرهم عند ربهم ولا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
arabic2: إن الذين آمنوا والذين هادوا والصابئون والنصارى من آمن بالله واليوم الآخر وعمل صالحا فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
english1: Indeed, those who believed and those who were Jews or Christians or Sabeans [before Prophet Muhammad] - those [among them] who believed in Allah and the Last Day and did righteousness - will have their reward with their Lord, and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.
english2: Indeed, those who have believed [in Prophet Muhammad] and those [before Him] who were Jews or Sabeans or Christians - those [among them] who believed in Allah and the Last Day and did righteousness - no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.

arabic1: وما كان جواب قومه إلا أن قالوا أخرجوهم من قريتكم ۖ إنهم أناس يتطهرون
arabic2: ۞ فما كان جواب قومه إلا أن قالوا أخرجوا آل لوط من قريتكم ۖ إنهم أناس يتطهرون
english1: But the answer of his people was only that they said, "Evict them from your city! Indeed, they are men who keep themselves pure."
english2: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."

arabic1: ومن الليل فسبحه وأدبار السجود
arabic2: ومن الليل فسبحه وإدبار النجوم
english1: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.
english2: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.

arabic1: إنا أنزلناه قرآنا عربيا لعلكم تعقلون
arabic2: إنا جعلناه قرآنا عربيا لعلكم تعقلون
english1: Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.
english2: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.

arabic1: فأنجيناه وأهله إلا امرأته كانت من الغابرين
arabic2: فأنجيناه وأهله إلا امرأته قدرناها من الغابرين
english1: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; she was of those who remained [with the evildoers].
english2: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.

arabic1: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا أولئك أصحاب النار ۖ هم فيها خالدون
arabic2: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا أولئك أصحاب النار خالدين فيها ۖ وبئس المصير
english1: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."
english2: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.

arabic1: إن الذين كفروا لن تغني عنهم أموالهم ولا أولادهم من الله شيئا ۖ وأولئك أصحاب النار ۚ هم فيها خالدون
arabic2: لن تغني عنهم أموالهم ولا أولادهم من الله شيئا ۚ أولئك أصحاب النار ۖ هم فيها خالدون
english1: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
english2: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

arabic1: ۞ وإلى عاد أخاهم هودا ۗ قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره ۚ أفلا تتقون
arabic2: وإلى عاد أخاهم هودا ۚ قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره ۖ إن أنتم إلا مفترون
english1: And to the 'Aad [We sent] their brother Hud. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. Then will you not fear Him?"
english2: And to 'Aad [We sent] their brother Hud. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors [of falsehood].

arabic1: وما أنتم بمعجزين في الأرض ولا في السماء ۖ وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
arabic2: وما أنتم بمعجزين في الأرض ۖ وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
english1: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allah any protector or any helper.
english2: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper.

arabic1: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بآياتنا أولئك أصحاب النار ۖ هم فيها خالدون
arabic2: والذين كذبوا بآياتنا واستكبروا عنها أولئك أصحاب النار ۖ هم فيها خالدون
english1: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."
english2: But the ones who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

arabic1: قالوا أإذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أإنا لمبعوثون
arabic2: وكانوا يقولون أئذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظاما أإنا لمبعوثون
english1: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
english2: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

arabic1: سبح لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۖ وهو العزيز الحكيم
arabic2: يسبح لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض الملك القدوس العزيز الحكيم
english1: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
english2: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic1: وإما ينزغنك من الشيطان نزغ فاستعذ بالله ۚ إنه سميع عليم
arabic2: وإما ينزغنك من الشيطان نزغ فاستعذ بالله ۖ إنه هو السميع العليم
english1: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing.
english2: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

arabic1: سبح لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض ۖ وهو العزيز الحكيم
arabic2: يسبح لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض الملك القدوس العزيز الحكيم
english1: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
english2: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic1: وقيل لهم أين ما كنتم تعبدون
arabic2: ثم قيل لهم أين ما كنتم تشركون
english1: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
english2: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]

arabic1: عالم الغيب والشهادة الكبير المتعال
arabic2: عالم الغيب والشهادة العزيز الحكيم
english1: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
english2: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

arabic1: قالوا يا ويلنا إنا كنا ظالمين
arabic2: قالوا سبحان ربنا إنا كنا ظالمين
english1: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
english2: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

arabic1: فأتوا بكتابكم إن كنتم صادقين
arabic2: فأتوا بآبائنا إن كنتم صادقين
english1: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
english2: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

arabic1: فما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون
arabic2: ما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يمتعون
english1: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
english2: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

arabic1: قال نعم وإنكم لمن المقربين
arabic2: قال نعم وإنكم إذا لمن المقربين
english1: He said, "Yes, and, [moreover], you will be among those made near [to me]."
english2: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

arabic1: وإذا السماء فرجت
arabic2: وإذا السماء كشطت
english1: And when the heaven is opened
english2: And when the sky is stripped away

arabic1: والليل إذا عسعس
arabic2: والليل إذا يسر
english1: And by the night as it closes in
english2: And [by] the night when it passes,

arabic1: والليل إذا يسر
arabic2: والليل إذا سجى
english1: And [by] the night when it passes,
english2: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

arabic1: والليل إذا يسر
arabic2: والليل إذا يغشى
english1: And [by] the night when it passes,
english2: By the night when it covers

arabic1: وألقي السحرة ساجدين
arabic2: فألقي السحرة ساجدين
english1: And the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].
english2: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].

arabic1: ثم كلا سيعلمون
arabic2: ثم كلا سوف تعلمون
english1: Then, no! They are going to know.
english2: Then no! You are going to know.

arabic1: وإذا الجبال نسفت
arabic2: وإذا الجبال سيرت
english1: And when the mountains are blown away
english2: And when the mountains are removed

arabic1: والنجم إذا هوى
arabic2: وإذا النجوم انكدرت
english1: By the star when it descends,
english2: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

arabic1: والليل إذا عسعس
arabic2: والليل إذا سجى
english1: And by the night as it closes in
english2: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

arabic1: والليل إذا يغشى
arabic2: والليل إذا سجى
english1: By the night when it covers
english2: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

arabic1: وكنوز ومقام كريم
arabic2: وزروع ومقام كريم
english1: And treasures and honorable station -
english2: And crops and noble sites

arabic1: ثم دمرنا الآخرين
arabic2: ثم أغرقنا الآخرين
english1: Then We destroyed the others.
english2: Then We drowned the disbelievers.

arabic1: والليل إذا عسعس
arabic2: والليل إذا يغشى
english1: And by the night as it closes in
english2: By the night when it covers

arabic1: ثم أغرقنا الآخرين
arabic2: ثم دمرنا الآخرين
english1: Then We drowned the others.
english2: Then We destroyed the others.

arabic1: والصبح إذا أسفر
arabic2: والصبح إذا تنفس
english1: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
english2: And by the dawn when it breathes

arabic1: وإذا البحار سجرت
arabic2: وإذا البحار فجرت
english1: And when the seas are filled with flame
english2: And when the seas are erupted
